mangalayatan-university-online.heading: One thing a UGC-DEB check does not tell you
paragraphs: In December 2024 the Ministry of Education told the Rajya Sabha that complaints received through the Central Vigilance Commission alleged that ten private universities had awarded PhD degrees improperly. Mangalayatan University was one of the ten named. The University Grants Commission forwarded those complaints to the relevant state governments for enquiry.

What has been reported since: the state governments of Uttarakhand and Madhya Pradesh cleared Quantum University and Sri Satya Sai University, and the UGC separately debarred OPJS, Sunrise and Singhania universities in Rajasthan from enrolling PhD scholars. No adverse finding against Mangalayatan University has been reported and no action against it has been announced.

Two things are worth keeping apart. The complaints concern the award of PhD degrees, not the online undergraduate and postgraduate programmes this page covers. And a complaint is not a finding. We record it because you may be about to pay fees and would reasonably want to know it exists, not because it settles anything.
mangalayatan-university-online.checkYourself: Ask the university directly for its current position, and check the UGC for any action listed against it.
